authentication: paid account (subscription); API/exports on higher plans
cost_notes: Public pricing observed 2026-11-09: from $229/month (or $183/month billed $2,198/year), higher tiers up to $4,310 listed. Contract price may differ.
free_tier: no free data tier; paid subscription with a public price list
historical_coverage: US sea/air import BoL plus selected other countries, years of history
known_limitations: PROBED 2026-11-09: the public pricing page is readable and lists real prices - observed tokens: $229 (monthly starting price), $183/mo when billed $2,198/yr, $359, $449, $1,999, $2,198, $4,310. The data itself is behind the paywall.
PAID_ONLY: no free API, no free bulk, no licence for redistribution; use would be internal-analysis only.
Bill-of-lading data is company-level shipment evidence - the correct counterpart to (and NOT interchangeable with) HS-code aggregate statistics.
US-centric; supplier/buyer relationship graphs are derived, not authoritative.
licence: proprietary commercial terms; redistribution of raw records not permitted
research_value: This is the class of source that actually answers firm-level supply-chain questions (which importer ships from which supplier, with HS codes and dates). It is uniformly paid, so MedRadar would have to buy it; no open substitute was found in this round.
timestamp_fields: record publication/update date inside the product (UNKNOWN without an account)
